newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan rescues 31 from Russian oil tanker.
newsitem.headline: Japan rescues 31 from Russian oil tanker.

text.p: Japanese authorities rescued 31 crew members of a Russian-registered oil tanker who were found adrift in life boats in a rough seas west of Japan on Thursday, Maritime Safety Agency officials said.
But one sailor was still missing and agency vessels and helicopters searched the area, officials said.
The sailors had earlier abandoned the 13,157-ton Nakhodka some 106 kilometers northeast of the Oki Islands in the Sea of Japan, about 700 km (420 miles) west of Tokyo, the agency officials said.
The vessel was carrying an estimated 1,900 tonnes of crude oil from China to Russia, Kyodo news agency reported.
It was not clear if any of the cargo was leaking.
The tanker was taking on water and listing amid high waves and poor visibility due to fog were reported in the area of the accident, they said.
